$comment: Keys are suite/case/tool. Entries may be scoped with platforms (array) and path (combined|per-case). A listed failure that starts passing is STALE and fails CI — remove it when the upstream limitation clears. An entry never turns a benchmark validity failure into a ranked PASS.
$comment-discipline: Expected still failing = accepted+reported; expected passing = stale = exit 1; unexpected failure = exit 1. Package upgrades re-run every plant automatically (versions are exactly pinned in package.json).

compile/server-render/verter.why: @verter/native 0.0.1-beta.5 compileMany(runtime-render) emits Vue-style modules and leaves Svelte runes uncompiled. The diagnostic timing remains unranked. Remove this entry when valid Svelte server output is observed.

compile/validity-client/verter-svelte.why: The published compileMany path fails the Svelte client runtime and source-map plants: Vue-style output, unresolved virtual modules, and Svelte syntax rejected by the parser. These are retained as failed validation, not ranked timings.

compile/validity-server/verter-svelte.why: The published compileMany path fails the Svelte server runtime and source-map plants: Vue-style output, unresolved virtual modules, and uncompiled runes. These are retained as failed validation, not ranked timings.

lint/html-injection/verter.why: Verter does not expose the shared raw-HTML diagnostic through this host API yet.

format/coverage/oxfmt.why: The pinned Oxfmt release excludes .svelte files; the gate prevents timing a no-op.

typecheck/missing-required-prop/svelte-c.why: svelte-check-rs reports the missing-required-prop error without a usable location (line 0), so pin-based scoring cannot accept it.

component-meta/callback-signatures/verte.why: Verter's published framework surface omits type text for function-typed props at this demand level, so parameter-count/type facts cannot be checked for it.

format/semantics/prettier.why: Reformatting separates from the following inline element with a newline, which Svelte renders as a visible space where the original had none — the formatter changes observable output for zero-space inline sequences.

format/semantics/rsvelte-fmt.why: Reformatting separates from the following inline element with a newline, which Svelte renders as a visible space where the original had none — the formatter changes observable output for zero-space inline sequences.

compile/validity-client/mrwaip-svelte-rs.why: CSS source maps use style-block-relative original lines instead of component-document positions (mapped 2:24 where the token is at 9:24).

compile/validity-server/mrwaip-svelte-rs.why: Server compile returns no js.map at all — the artifact omits the source map the official compiler always emits.

compile/validity-client/rsvelte-wasm.why: JS source-map columns count UTF-8 bytes instead of UTF-16 code units (anchors after a non-BMP emoji shift by +2), and the template anchor has no original mapping.

compile/validity-client/rsvelte-native.why: JS source-map columns count UTF-8 bytes instead of UTF-16 code units (anchors after a non-BMP emoji shift by +2), and the template anchor has no original mapping.

typecheck/clean-generics/verter-tsc.why: verter-tsc 0.0.1-beta.5 reports TS2304 "Cannot find name 'T'" on the clean generics plant: the <script generics="T"> parameter is not carried into its tsc bridge, so the clean plant is not clean for this tool. Remove this entry when the generics plant checks clean.
